title: Acyclic orientations of mixed graphs
summary: A mixed graph $M=(V,E\cup A)$ is acyclic if its directed part $(V,A)$ is an acyclic digraph. In this note we study the so-called orientation completion problem for the class of acyclic mixed graphs. That is, given an acyclic mixed graph $M$ and a property ${\cal P}$; can we orient the edges of $M$ so that the resulting digraph is acyclic and has property ${\cal P}$.
